The wind direction is expected to shift from the southwest to the southeast, leading to an increase in moisture content in the air. As a result, the humidity levels will remain high, making it feel like 26°C in the shade and 30°C in the sun. The rainfall accumulation on Monday is expected to range from 20 mm to 30 mm, with some areas possibly experiencing heavier downpours. The Aso Rock area, being one of the highest points in the city, will likely experience less rainfall than the surrounding areas. My best guess is that the rain will clear out by around 10 pm, leaving behind a cooler and more comfortable evening. The high humidity levels on Monday will make it feel oppressive in the city, especially in areas with high population density such as Wuse and Gwarinpa. The heat index, which takes into account the temperature and humidity, will make it feel like 30°C in these areas, even though the actual temperature may be lower.
